api_base_url.description: Base URL of the DebCI backend API. Should include scheme and hostname, e.g., https://debci.example.com

worker_name.description: Unique name for this worker in the DebCI fleet. Used for identification and logging.

jobs.description: Maximum number of concurrent build/test jobs this worker will accept.

work_dir.description: Directory used for job workspaces, chroots, and logs. Must have sufficient disk space.

min_free_space.description: Minimum free disk space (in MB) required in WORK_DIR before the worker refuses new jobs.

cpu_mask.description: Hexadecimal CPU affinity mask (e.g., '0x3' for CPUs 0–1). Leave empty to use all CPUs.

cross_build.description: Allow building packages for foreign architectures (requires qemu-user-static and appropriate binfmt_misc support).

items.description: Architecture name as known to dpkg and APT (e.g., 'arm64', 'ppc64el', 's390x'). Must match available cross-toolchains and chroot support.

supported_architectures.description: List of architectures this worker can build for. Must match installed cross-toolchains and chroot definitions.

items.description: An additional APT repository to include during package installation.

description.description: Human-readable label for the repository (used in comments).

components.description: Comma- or space-separated components (e.g., 'main contrib non-free').

architectures.description: Optional list of architectures the repo supports (for multiarch or cross-build repos).

extra_repos.description: List of extra APT repositories to add to the build environment (e.g., backports, local repos).

api_tls_cert.description: Path to client TLS certificate (PEM format) for mutual TLS with the API endpoint. Leave empty if not required.

api_tls_key.description: Path to client TLS private key (PEM format, unencrypted). Required if API_TLS_CERT is set.

api_ca_cert.description: Path to CA certificate bundle used to verify the API endpoint's TLS certificate.

setup_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) allowed for job setup (chroot creation, package installation, etc.).

build_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) allowed for actual build/test execution per job.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging to console and job logs (recommended only for troubleshooting).
